summary: Cut the missions domain (mission runs and steps, person work, work lists, mission lists and eligibility, ad hoc work, delegation, lanes, arrangements, coordination, declarations, the graph and the reference checks) out of st3-store at function level into the new st3-missions crate; its Store methods are extension traits that st3-daemon re-exports, and every module keeps its old path.
